title: The Brake on the Nerve

mood.label: Heavy going, one light on
mood.summary: A world at 41/100 — a Himalayan flood with 600 dead and 2,000 missing dominates, gunfire hits Niamey, Gaza's ceasefire wobbles and Norway's king dies; against it, a Malian prisoner swap, an Ecuadorian conviction, Bougainville's vote and a nerve-repair discovery hold a thin light.

lines: The valley kept the river's new address —
six hundred counted, two thousand still a guess.
A trekker's boot, a bridge that isn't there,
and Niamey woke to gunfire in the air.
A king let go of Norway at eighty-nine;
near Kyiv, six were hurt and one long line.
In Mali someone's son walked out a gate,
in Quito a president was told to wait.
They found the brake — the protein saying stop,
the thing inside the nerve that won't let go.
Somewhere a switch was waiting to be thrown;
heavy going, and still the light gets through.
